name: Pulsedive indicator info (pulsedive.com/api)
tier_rationale: Small company with an identifiable operator, public API documentation, terms and more than two years of public track record (A8 community); P160 final condition 4: 'Registry provider pulsedive: tier community, terms key-terms'.

reliability.justification: Community threat-intel aggregator: risk is computed from public feeds and Pulsedive's own scans; feeds[] re-serve abuse.ch, Bambenek, OpenPhish and other lists, so memberships are deduplicated against the local feeds (P160 cond 4).

pulsedive.description: Pulsedive API key (sent as the key= query parameter of info.php; masked by the redactor and hashed into the cache key)
pulsedive.plan_hint: Use a company account on a plan recorded as business-compatible (key_plans.pulsedive='business', P160 cond 1); keyless community use is not built.

info.title: Pulsedive info.php?indicator= (indicator report) and explore.php (read-only search); analyze.php and every probe/scan/submit endpoint are never built

terms.quote: P160 cond 1 (binding council text): keyed only in this build (key 'pulsedive'); keyless community use stays unbuilt until legal records its terms (the terms pages are JS-only, unverified 2026-11-26). The key comes from a company account on a plan recorded as business-compatible (key_plans.pulsedive='business'). Registry provider pulsedive: tier community, terms key-terms.

info.notes: Research C0344 (verified live 2026-11-26 keyless: 200 from Apache, X-Requests-Remaining-Second/Day headers). Documented: 404 {"error":"Indicator not found."} (EMPTY 'not in Pulsedive', never clean), 401 'Invalid API key.' (NEEDS_KEY), 429 'API rate limit exceeded: 1 requests per second' (RATE_LIMITED; QUOTA when the day/month counter is 0). Never analyze.php: it makes Pulsedive actively scan the indicator (target contact, rule 7). Comments, cookies, WHOIS and HTTP headers are never copied. Aggregator: feeds[] are upstream provenance; the module names the families behind its verdict in finding data['upstream_families'] so CR27 counts them once (P171/P159).
info.licensed_alternative: A Pulsedive company plan (API/Commercial) recorded by legal as key_plans.pulsedive='business'; meanwhile the direct feeds it re-serves and the manual Pulsedive indicator page.

x_quota_note: rate_per_second is the documented free-account limit ('API rate limit exceeded: 1 requests per second', docs 2026-11-26); day and month limits are plan-specific and unpublished: the module reads X-Requests-Remaining-Day/Month and treats a 429 with a 0 day/month counter as QUOTA. Replace with the recorded plan's limits (P160 cond 3, P334).
notes: Owned by batch p3-G07-1 (P160, module threat_intel_ioc/pulsedive). The key 'pulsedive' is the legacy config.KNOWN_KEYS entry; this fragment adds the alias V3LUM_PULSEDIVE_KEY and the plan hint. Cache 24 h (cond 3).
